summary.text: Phyresis is the Phyrexian oil-based transformation that infects and reshapes minds and bodies.

bio.text: Vraska narrates being compleated, as her throat and tendrils turn to metal, she petrifies Phyrexian agents until she is overwhelmed, and her self retreats into a hidden corner of her mind.
On the beach in his mind, Jace commands his body to fight the oil as a virus.

status.text: The last event shows Jace fighting the oil in his mind as a virus, and a later page says that he and Vraska fight off the transformation.
